title: Trading Platform — Services Overview
description: Uptime, latency, SLI/SLO, error rates, request totals, business KPIs and CPU/memory for every service, container and node.

panels.title: Service status (black-box probe)
panels.description: 1 = /health endpoint answered 2xx in the last probe.

panels.title: Container restarts (start-time changes)
panels.description: Non-zero = the container restarted inside the selected range.

panels.title: Error rate % (5xx) by service
panels.description: Share of requests answered with HTTP 5xx. Red line = 1%.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service", http_route!~"/actuator.*|/health.*"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: SLI / SLO  (availability target 99.9 %, latency target 95 % under 500 ms)
Availability SLI (non-5xx)
panels.description: Good requests / all requests in the selected range. SLO: 99.9 %.

panels.title: Latency SLI (requests < 500 ms)
panels.description: Share of requests served in 500 ms or less. SLO: 95 %.

panels.title: Error budget remaining
panels.description: Budget = 0.1 % of requests may fail (99.9 % SLO). 100 % = untouched.

panels.title: Error-budget burn rate (1h window) by service
panels.description: 1.0 = burning the budget exactly as fast as the SLO allows. >1 = SLO at risk. (Needs ≥1h of data.)

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - (sum by (service_name) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_route!~"/actuator.*|/health.*", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or (0 * sum by (service_name) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_route!~"/actuator.*|/health.*"}[$__range])))) / sum by (service_name) (increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_route!~"/actuator.*|/health.*"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Logins failed
panels.description: Wrong e-mail/password. A sudden spike can indicate credential stuffing.

panels.title: AI service unavailable
panels.description: Orders that were processed without a fraud verdict because ai-service did not answer.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / on (name) sum by (name) (container_spec_cpu_quota{name!=""} / container_spec_cpu_period{name!=""} > 0)

panels.title: Container memory % of limit
panels.description: Working-set memory / container limit. Red line = alert threshold.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / on (name) sum by (name) (container_spec_cpu_quota{name!=""} / container_spec_cpu_period{name!=""} > 0)

panels.title: Services up
panels.description: Out of 8 probed services. Firing Grafana alerts: Alerting -> Alert rules.

panels.title: Logs & traces  (open a log line → “Open trace in Tempo”)
Application logs
panels.description: Expand a line and click the trace_id link to jump to the trace and its spans.

panels.title: Recent error traces
panels.description: TraceQL search. Click a trace to see spans; from a span use “Logs for this span”.
